algorithm.title: Cognitive bias and diagnostic error in endometriosis

nodes.text: Chronic pelvic pain + cyclic bowel symptoms (dyschezia, diarrhea): avoid premature closure
Recognize anchoring bias: attributing severe pelvic symptoms solely to irritable bowel syndrome
Perform comprehensive pelvic examination + transvaginal ultrasound
**Endometrioma or deep infiltrating nodules visualized:** initiate targeted hormonal or surgical care
**Ultrasound negative but high suspicion:** diagnostic laparoscopy for definitive tissue diagnosis
Implement diagnostic time-outs and re-evaluate when symptoms fail conservative management
